title: Initial configuration for a register computation
statement: Given an input string $x$ of Boolean symbols, a label $l$, a natural-number value $v(r)$ for each of $m$ registers, and a Boolean output string, define a machine configuration with state $(l,\mathrm{start})$, input head at the first position, each register tape containing the binary expansion of its assigned value, every work-tape head at position zero, and the specified output string.
hypotheses_covered: Natural-number value assigned to each register
